digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge preview/sync and reconcile command parser
propositions: Canonical preview must render plan with exact field-level drift from a single active-ticket dry-run differ pass without invoking reconcile-check or launching a second comparison.

Canonical preview and sync must run lock-free, loading a coherent read-only snapshot without acquiring, purging, stealing, or writing the pass lock while legacy reconcile-check retains its independent lock-free diagnostic branch.

Legacy reconcile-check retains its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair comparison behavior, lock-free execution, diagnostic JSON artifact, and exit semantics unchanged as a distinct compatibility route.

Argparse must use allow_abbrev=False to make undocumented prefix abbreviations and unknown options fail with invocation error 2 before any repository or lock mutation, while documented legacy options like --mode dry-run remain valid.

Canonical preview and canonical sync must emit field-comparable manifest envelopes with the same retained structure including applied/failed tally, while legacy uncapped LIVE callers retain the historical tally-only no-retained-manifest contract.
Existing capped canonical sync, legacy bootstrap applied/deferred partitions, and all legacy CLI/library/MCP/workflow entry points must retain their historical observable behavior.
